Studio's tokens are the consumer's compiled theme (/api/designer/globals.css from the pinned themes.* slots), so --primary is mutated at its source: the themes.primary candidate the slot pins (its light value is occurrence 0; the pin is re-pointed at the mutated bytes for the run). The build seam rebuilds dist/studio; the process serving the base URL must load that build.
